doc.title: Jason Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2025

title: Liner notes and the album Places
summary: Rowe praises the liner notes on Places; Palmer writes them for all his roughly twenty records.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Liner notes. That’s where my education came from. And I had made a note, you had a — sorry about that fan — you had a recording called “Places” I believe. And you had extensive liner notes and I said, yeah, I gave that a thumbs up.
Um hum. Yeah I write all the liner notes to all of my records. I’ve gotten about 20 of them out commercially and yeah, I’ve written to all of them I believe.
Yeah — I’m debating — do you hear that noise as much as I do?
